summary: Ryanair Holdings PLC filed a Form 6-K containing a standard TR-1 notification of major holdings. The Capital Group Companies, Inc. disclosed crossing above 16.00% of total voting rights (from 15.07%), holding 167,062,813 voting rights (16.08%) as of July 7, 2026. This is a routine passive shareholding disclosure under Irish takeover rules, not a special situation. No bid, offer, or strategic action is involved. The filing is merely a regulatory threshold notification; no deal terms, board recommendation, or structural mechanics are present. There is no event to watch.
